plan: [Given independent private values and that the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid (a Vickrey-style outcome), truthful bidding is weakly dominant. Sealed bids set exit prices in the ascending clock; you automatically exit at your sealed bid and pay the highest other bid if you win. With v=47, bidding 47 maximizes expected profit (win whenever others' highest <47, pay second-highest, no incentive to shade or overbid). Ties are random but do not change truth-telling optimality.]

[The sealed-bid + clock exit means the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid—this is effectively a Vickrey (second-price) auction. In such auctions, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. With independent draws and no prior history to exploit, bidding my true private value maximizes expected surplus and long-run profit. I will bid my value, $33.]
